_comment: Phase 2 pipeline config. Values left null are required inputs the pipeline will NOT guess - it leaves the dependent output column null rather than estimating.
_appreciation_factor_annual_comment: Annual county/market appreciation rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.045 for 4.5%/yr), used to project a property's last sale price forward to today for the equity proxy. Supply a source (e.g. FHFA HPI for the Reading MSA, or a county-specific figure) when you set this.
_recent_sale_years_threshold_comment: Properties sold within this many years are flagged recently_sold=True (negative signal in Phase 3 scoring).
_tenure_sweet_spot_comment: Reference range only (used by Phase 3 scoring, not Phase 2). Kept here so both phases read one config.
_berks_county_zips_comment: Optional: list of Berks County ZIP codes, used only as a supplementary out-of-county mailing signal if you want to add it later. Not required - out-of-state mailing (STATECODE != 'PA') is used as the primary absentee corroborator instead, since it needs no external ZIP list.
